request.query: Which drugs are tested together in combination in melanoma trials?

visualization.title: Drugs given together in the same arm: Melanoma

response.answer_summary: The drugs most often given together in the same arm are Ipilimumab + Nivolumab (112 trials), Cyclophosphamide + Fludarabine (57 trials), Dabrafenib + Trametinib (44 trials). Based on 3,140 trials from ClinicalTrials.gov.
